name: Seneca Rocks & the Monongahela
summary: A dramatic quartzite fin rising over a mountain valley — the East's great climbing crag — in a forest of the state's highest peaks and wild high plains.

item.title: Seneca Rocks, Spruce Knob & Dolly Sods
item.blurb: Hike to the base of the climbing fin, drive up Spruce Knob (the state's highest point), and see the tundra-like Dolly Sods.
